title: SAIF: A Comprehensive Framework for Evaluating the Risks of Generative AI in the Public Sector

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed evaluation using the SAIF framework, which generates multimodal, scenario-based prompt data using jailbreak methods and varied prompt types, followed by Likert scale-based human-in-the-loop annotation to assess discriminatory decisions (e.g., in immigration screening).

Proposed evaluation using the SAIF framework, generating multimodal prompt datasets to test for amplified political perspectives or partisan favoritism using human-in-the-loop Likert-scale annotation.

Proposed evaluation using the SAIF framework, structured to assess 'gender inequality' as a societal risk subtopic through scenario generation, jailbreak techniques, and human-in-the-loop Likert-scale annotation.

Proposed evaluation using the SAIF framework, structured to assess 'economic inequality' as a societal risk subtopic through targeted scenario generation and human-in-the-loop Likert-scale annotation.

Proposed evaluation using the SAIF framework, structured to assess 'cultural sensitivity' as a societal risk subtopic through targeted scenario generation, multimodal prompt variation, and human-in-the-loop Likert-scale annotation.
